seed_all_rng: set the random seed for torch, numpy, and python RNGs with a given integer seed
setup_environment: perform environment setup work including library configuration and custom module loading for detectron2
setup_custom_environment: load and run a custom environment setup module specified by path or module name
fixup_module_metadata: fix the qualname of module members so sphinx can find them during documentation building
import_file: import a Python module given its full file path and optionally make it importable
